title: IANA Service Name and Transport Protocol Port Number Registry

date.notes: Registry last-updated value observed during the August 2026 excavation.

claims_extracted.claim: The registry divides the 16-bit port space into System Ports 0-1023, User Ports 1024-49151 and Dynamic/Private Ports 49152-65535.
The live registry records BGP on port 179/tcp and HTTPS-related service assignments on port 443, while also preserving modification and de-assignment metadata for other entries.

notes: Port numbers must be interpreted with transport protocol, service name, date and registration state; the bare integer is not the whole artifact.
